# Brilliant Directories

Brilliant Directories is an all-in-one platform that enables users to create and manage online membership communities and business directories.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/brilliant-directories/.

## Actions

- **Create User**: This tool creates a new user record in the brilliant directories website database.
- **Delete User**: This tool deletes an existing user record from the brilliant directories website database.
- **Get Data Categories** (read-only): This tool fetches all data categories in a brilliant directories website.
- **Get Lead Fields** (read-only): This tool retrieves all available fields in the leads table from a brilliant directories website.
- **Get Reviews Fields** (read-only): This tool retrieves all the available fields in the users reviews table from a brilliant directories website.
- **Get User Fields** (read-only): This tool fetches all available fields from the users data table in your brilliant directories website.
